description: October 27 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 27 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the first decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: Personality of an October 27 birthday
paragraphs: Three degrees of Scorpio and the birthday number 9 make October 27 a date of endings and renewals. Pluto, ruling the sign and its first decan, is associated with letting go and starting again, and 9 is numerology's number of completion and compassion. The blend suggests someone who helps others through hard transitions because they have navigated plenty themselves.

By noon UTC on October 27, the Sun has normally reached roughly 3° of Scorpio. That places the date in the Scorpio decan that astrologers give to Pluto, the first of three. Pluto rules Scorpio in modern astrology and also governs its first decan, so late October and the first days of November hold the sign in concentrated form. This decan is traditionally associated with intensity, privacy and a capacity to go deep into whatever it touches, whether a relationship, a mystery or a personal reinvention. Trust tends to be slow and, once given, complete. Doubled Pluto can bring a strong will and a reluctance to show vulnerability. Natives often find their power in honest transformation: releasing what no longer fits rather than guarding it out of habit.

sections.heading: Numerology of the October 27 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same October 27 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: October 27 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 27 is the 300th day of the year (301st in a leap year). In most years Sagittarius season is under way by November 23, 27 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 27 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. October 27 is also the birthday of Theodore Roosevelt (1858), Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (1945) and Sylvia Plath (1932).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 27?
faq.answer: October 27 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 27 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 27?
faq.answer: By October 27 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 27?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an October 27 birthday are Theodore Roosevelt (1858), Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (1945) and Sylvia Plath (1932). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
